grid.rule: every square that intersects the city boundary, including squares with no crime

ranking.population_source: 2020 census blocks (POP20), Los Angeles County GIS

meta.percentile_method: Only squares with at least 50 residents (2020 census) and at least 50% of their area inside the city boundary are ranked (4024 of 5470). Each gets a lighting percentile (satellite radiance, 0 = darkest) and a NIGHTTIME violent-crime percentile (8 PM-6 AM, 0 = lowest), both ranked over those squares, including ones with no crime; the sliders flag squares at or below a lighting percentile AND at or above a crime percentile

lighting.label: VIIRS Black Marble annual radiance, 2023–2025 average
lighting.source: NASA Black Marble VNP46A4 annual radiance (LAADS DAAC)
lighting.method: area-weighted mean of the 15-arc-second pixels overlapping each square (counting only the part of the square inside the city boundary), per year; squares with no valid pixels in a year take the mean of the 3 nearest valid squares; years averaged with equal weight
